content:
alex: Quick heads-up — saw a weird regression in kernel-elector where it picks GQA path for MQA models when paged KV cache is enabled. Latency jumps ~20% on seq len 1024 bursts. Profiling attached.

alex: profiler snippet:
```
CPU  GPU  kernel   time_ms
0    0    gqa_core 12.4
0    0    mqa_core 9.8
0    0    kv_load  3.1
... (avg over 500 iters)
```

alex: Last known good was 214.3k tokens/s, now 176.7k. Paging pressure + small blocksize seems to trigger wrong kernel scoring.

maria: :eyes: can you paste the kernel score log? also which block_size and page_size?

alex: score log:
```
norm_score(gqa)=0.88
norm_score(mqa)=0.79
kv_page_miss=0.23
block_size=64
page_size=4096
policy: seqlen_threshold=512
```

sam: fwiw I ran quick with block_size=128 and page_size=8192 — drop in latency ~8%. cmd: `./bench --model=mqa --kv-paged --block=128 --page=8192` results: p50 78ms -> 72ms

jin: Sounds like kernel-elector's frag penalty needs to factor in page miss rate more aggressively. Maybe add an additive penalty term: score -= alpha * page_miss. alpha tuned per arch.

maria: agree. Also maybe we should prefer path that keeps KV prefetch on GQA->MQA transitions. Edge cases when seqlen spikes cause GQA to be chosen because shorter critical path but then KV hits kill it.

perf-bot: summary: created perf-issue #3892, attached logs (2155554321). Suggested next steps: (1) autotune run with block_size [64,128,256] (2) add page_miss coefficient to elector scoring (3) canary with 10% traffic.

alex: I'll run autotune tomorrow and post results. Can someone add canary config for dedicated cluster? @maria @jin

maria: added canary, 10% traffic, fallback to mqa_core if p95>200ms. :white_check_mark:

sam: ping me when autotune runs finish, will re-run benchmarks.

jin: I'll prototype elector change and bench on A100/MI250 tomorrow.

alex: thanks all. keeping this thread for diffs and numbers.
